$comment: These are compatibility profiles: the hostnames each site needs in order to
work. They are suggestions a parent can add with one tap. NOTHING here is
enabled, installed, or endorsed by this project, and none of these sites is
Every allowHosts list below was measured by visiting the site and recording
what it loaded. Analytics-only hosts are left out on purpose - the site works
without them. Treat each list as a floor, not a ceiling: if something is
missing, the app will tell you which host to add.
Sites change. If one stops working, use 'Add a site' in the app to re-probe
it, or run:  npm run probe -- --probe=https://example.com
blockAds:false means the site is left exactly as its operator intended. The
kiosk still contains the child; only the ad filtering is off.

suggestions.title: Scratch
suggestions.notes: Make your own games and animations. Run by MIT, non-profit, no advertising.
suggestions.blurb: Make your own games and animations, then play them.

suggestions.title: PBS Kids
suggestions.notes: Games from US public broadcasting. Made for pre-schoolers.
suggestions.blurb: Games with the characters from US public television.

suggestions.title: Space
suggestions.notes: NASA's space games and pictures for children. US government, no advertising.
suggestions.blurb: Space games, pictures and facts for children.

suggestions.title: Toy Theater
suggestions.notes: Simple educational games, no accounts needed. The free site carries advertising.
suggestions.blurb: Simple games: shapes, numbers, music and drawing.

suggestions.title: Reading
suggestions.notes: Letters, phonics and early reading. Much of it is free.

suggestions.title: Animals
suggestions.notes: Animal facts, photos and videos. Ad filtering is OFF for this profile on purpose: Disney's terms, which cover this site, forbid interfering with how it works. The kiosk still stops your child leaving it.

suggestions.title: ABCya
suggestions.notes: Educational games by school grade. The free tier carries advertising.
suggestions.blurb: Educational games, sorted by school year.

suggestions.title: Poki
suggestions.notes: A large free browser-game portal. Ad-supported; please read DISCLAIMER.md before enabling.
suggestions.blurb: A big free games portal, with plenty of choice.

suggestions.title: Music
suggestions.notes: Music experiments you play with by touching and dragging. Made by Google Creative Lab, no advertising.
suggestions.blurb: Draw a song and hear it play back.
